verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Chargebee subscriptions can include coupons and discounts. Nothing in the pack documents free trials, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or trial-end notifications. The dunning email reminders cover failed payments, not trial-end notices, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: free-trial configuration, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, trial-end notifications meeting card-network rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules

citations.quote: Optionally, it can also incorporate one or more associated addons, charges, coupons, and discounts.
